repos.brief:
**What it does:** A structured, open-source curriculum of 523 lessons across 20 phases (~342 hours) that teaches AI engineering in Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia, with each lesson producing a reusable artifact — prompt, skill, agent, or MCP server.

**Why now:** The repo gained 35,841 stars in a single week, signaling a sharp spike in developer interest that makes it a live community resource rather than a static reference.

**Build with it:** Pick a single Phase and implement its MCP server lesson to ship a working tool directly integrable with Claude or ChatGPT marketplaces via NitroStack's free cloud deployment.

**What it does:** HyperFrames is an open-source TypeScript framework that renders deterministic MP4 videos from HTML, CSS, and seekable animations using Chrome's BeginFrame API via Puppeteer and FFmpeg.

**Why now:** The repo gained 33,000+ stars this week alongside an HN thread titled "Show HN: HyperFrames – Render Video from HTML via Chrome's BeginFrame API," signaling a sharp surge in builder attention.

**Build with it:** Install the Claude Code plugin (`claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes`) and use the `/hyperframes` router skill to let an agent plan, write, and render a video directly from a prompt.

**What it does:** Scrapling is a Python web scraping framework that handles adaptive element-finding, stealth browser automation via Playwright, and full-scale crawling from a single unified API.

**Why now:** The repo gained 24,000+ stars in a single week alongside an HN thread, signaling a sudden surge of builder attention worth riding while community momentum is high.

**Build with it:** Drop Scrapling's Playwright-backed fetcher into an existing Python scraper to replace brittle CSS selectors with its adaptive element-matching, which automatically re-locates elements when page structure changes.

**What it does:** Graphify parses any codebase (plus docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs) into a queryable knowledge graph using local, deterministic AST analysis via tree-sitter, with every graph edge explained and no vector store required.

**Why now:** The repo gained 1,880 stars this week and ships as a native `/graphify` skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI — all four AI coding environments that are currently seeing active developer adoption.

**Build with it:** Register the Graphify MCP server via Smithery into your Cursor or Claude Code setup, then run `/graphify` against an unfamiliar repo to get structured, edge-labeled graph answers instead of embedding-based guesses.

**What it does:** `security-audit-skill` is a coding-agent skill that orchestrates isolated sub-agents through six structured phases—recon, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, schema-validated output, independent record verification, and neutral reporting—producing machine-readable `findings.json` and auditor-grade markdown reports.

**Why now:** The repo gained 1,772 stars this week, coinciding with Cloudflare's published blog post "Build your own vulnerability harness" that credits this skill as the seed for their fleet-wide vulnerability discovery system.

**Build with it:** Drop `SKILL.md` and the relevant attack-class files (e.g., `AI-AND-LLM.md` for LLM-backed targets) into your coding agent's context, point it at a repo, and get structured `findings.json` output validated against the bundled `report-schema.json` as a repeatable audit step in CI.

**What it does:** Agency Agents is a collection of markdown-defined AI agent personas—frontend developers, community managers, reality checkers, and more—each with explicit workflows and deliverables, installable into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other tools via shell scripts or a native desktop app.

**Why now:** The companion desktop app (agencyagents.app) just shipped with native macOS/Linux/Windows support and one-click installs into Gemini CLI and OpenCode, landing the same week the repo crossed 158K stars.

**Build with it:** Copy a single agent `.md` file from the `engineering/` directory into `~/.claude/agents/` and invoke it by name in Claude Code to add a scoped specialist persona to an existing coding session.

**What it does:** VoiceStudio is a fully local, open-source desktop app covering voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages, powered by k2-fsa/OmniVoice by default.

**Why now:** The repo gained 1,589 stars this week, signaling a current surge in builder attention worth catching early.

**Build with it:** Use the exposed local MCP endpoint to wire voice cloning directly into an AI agent pipeline — clone a voice sample, then call the API from your agent to generate dubbed audio without touching a remote service.

**What it does:** A collection of markdown skill files that give AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf) specialized marketing workflows covering CRO, SEO, copywriting, email, and analytics, anchored by a `product-marketing` skill that every other skill reads first for context.

**Why now:** The repo crossed 53K stars with 1,500+ added this week, signaling a sharp spike in developer-marketer crossover adoption as Claude Code usage accelerates.

**Build with it:** Drop the `cro` skill file into a Claude Code project and point it at a landing page to get conversion-focused copy and A/B test recommendations grounded in your actual product positioning.

**What it does:** A Claude coding-assistant plugin that rewrites LLM responses to lead with the action, number steps, and cut filler — enforced via 10 rules in a forkable `SKILL.md`.

**Why now:** The repo crossed 54,000 stars with nearly 1,500 added this week, signaling a sharp spike in developer frustration with verbose AI coding-assistant output.

**Build with it:** Fork the repo, edit `skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md` to tighten or relax the 10 rules for your team's workflow, then swap in your version with `claude plugin marketplace add <your-username>/i-have-adhd`.

**What it does:** `/brag` is an agent skill that reads your project and produces a 20-second shareable launch video with music, motion, and share copy via one command, powered by Hyperframes.

**Why now:** The repo gained 1,367 stars this week alongside the release of `/brag-slim`, a leaner variant built specifically for Claude Opus 4.5 that drops the Hyperframes dependency while keeping the same creative output.

**Build with it:** Install into Claude Code with `/plugin install brag@brag`, then run `/brag --tone "..."` at the end of your next project to generate a `brag-output/` folder ready to post.
